chars.R: RACHID: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black jeans and white sneakers.
chars.W: WIFE: a young woman wearing a long burgundy satin dress with a gold belt and a cream headscarf-free look, gold bangles on her wrists.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Moroccan living room in Marrakech (zellige tiles, low sofa, brass lamp), the WIFE hides her smartphone behind her back with a nervous look while RACHID, standing in front of her, stares at her suspiciously with crossed arms. Open tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan doctor's clinic office, the doctor's desk in front of them, the WIFE sits on a chair crying with her face in her hands while RACHID sits beside her with his hand on her shoulder, sad and worried.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Evening in the Moroccan apartment, RACHID and the WIFE sit together at a low round table eating a tajine, smiling at each other warmly, cozy lamp light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: RACHID relaxes on the Moroccan sofa watching TV with a glass of mint tea; in the background the WIFE walks into the kitchen; her smartphone lies on the sofa cushion next to RACHID, its screen glowing. Calm but ominous mood, dim light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: RACHID on the sofa turns his head toward the glowing smartphone vibrating on the cushion beside him, curious, frozen in mid-gesture with his tea glass. Seen from a medium distance, full body visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: RACHID sitting on the sofa picks up the glowing smartphone and looks at its screen with raised eyebrows, puzzled. The screen faces him, away from the viewer (no visible screen content).

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: RACHID standing in the living room holds the smartphone with both hands, mouth wide open in shock, leaning back, the phone screen facing him and away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the foreground RACHID grips the smartphone with an angry, betrayed expression, clenching his fist; in the background through the kitchen doorway the WIFE cooks at the stove, unaware, her back turned.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark bedroom lit only by the cold blue glow of a smartphone: RACHID sits on the edge of the bed scrolling the phone, horrified, sweating; behind him the WIFE sleeps peacefully under the blanket.
